pull-request-header: **Merge this PR when you're ready to ship.** Each section below shows the new version and changelog computed from Conventional Commits since the last release. Merging publishes `cloudtracer` to npm for a CLI bump, and attaches a fresh `.zip` to the `extension-v<version>` GitHub Release for an extension bump. Full flow in [RELEASING.md](https://github.com/timothyjordan/cloudtracer/blob/main/RELEASING.md). This PR refreshes on every push to `main`, so it always reflects what would ship right now.
pull-request-footer: _Need to republish after an infra failure? Use the `Release` workflow's manual `workflow_dispatch` with the package path (`.` or `extension`). Don't use that for routine releases._
